notes: Corrected: opening 'they' moved out of the participle's unit and marked added. The participle מַחֲזִיקִים is not inflected for person, and no nominal in this verse denotes its subject; rule 25 states that a participle in a verbless clause takes only the copula/predicate and rule 20 marks a referential subject pronoun answering to no morpheme added. The previous reading (pronoun with the participle) is the named alternative.
